material_states.name: Dissolve CuCl/InCl3 in TOP; transfer air-free into2L three-neck reactor
Load funnel with Se and lithium silylamide in anhydrous toluene
Heat reactor under vacuum at100°C for1h
Apply mild vacuum, then close vacuum valve before opening addition funnel
Open feed stopcock for fast Se/amide injection
After temperature drops to200°C, slowly increase to220°C during5min growth
Terminate first with hot water bath, then ice-water bath
Mix crude with toluene/methanol, centrifuge; decant upper fraction
Select optional lower-phase cleanup with toluene/methanol
Mix NC-rich fraction with toluene, ethanol and methanol; centrifuge
Disperse in a nonpolar solvent; exact identity and volume not specified
